label: Langrisser I & II (PlayStation, JP)
_comment: One disc, two complete games, one boot executable. Each game has its own directory holding the same file names, so a tool that reads one reads the other with --game.
_max_font_slot_comment: FONT.DAT is a whole file of exactly 1536 slots, so nothing follows the plane to overrun.

verify.note: SLPM 86798 data track. Every file the patch touches lives on it; the whole-image hash is not comparable across rips because a mixed-mode dump may or may not store the audio pregap.
